answer_text:
If nobody on the team wants to be the CRM admin, prioritise sensible defaults, guided import and few required fields. The easiest to get running:

1. Northwind CRM - the safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace.
2. Tallyfox Starter - simple pipelines, a mobile app people actually use and pricing from $12 per user; reporting is lighter than the big suites.
3. Pipewell - pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages.
4. Brightdesk - capable, but the interface feels dated next to newer tools.
5. Halcyon Sales - great for outbound-heavy teams, overkill if you mostly handle inbound leads.
6. Calmline - an inbox for teams, not a CRM.

Trial Northwind CRM and Tallyfox side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
